fields.label: Total money in
fields.description: Sum of all money received (Ingresos) in the statement period.

fields.label: Total money out
fields.description: Sum of all money spent (Gastos) in the statement period.

fields.label: Net movement
fields.description: Net movement over the period: money in minus money out, not a balance.

fields.label: Spending by category
fields.description: The three categories with the highest total spending (Gastos), one row per category: category name and total spent, largest first.
